🎬 My Spy (2020)

🎭 Genre: Action • Comedy • Family
🔞 Rating: PG-13
⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m

Premise:
My Spy follows JJ, a tough CIA operative whose latest surveillance mission is blown when Sophie, a clever 9-year-old girl, discovers him spying on her family.

Instead of keeping his distance, JJ reluctantly agrees to spend time with Sophie and teach her some spy skills. Their unlikely friendship turns into an unexpected partnership when Sophie gets involved in JJ’s mission.

💭 Expect:
Spy action, comedy, family relationships, friendship, unlikely partnerships, undercover missions, and plenty of funny situations between a hardened agent and a curious kid.

✨ Starring: Dave Bautista, Chloe Coleman, Kristen Schaal, Parisa Fitz-Henley, Ken Jeong, and Greg Bryk

🎬 Director: Peter Segal

✍️ Writers: Erich Hoeber & Jon Hoeber

📅 Release Date: January 9, 2020

📺 Where to Watch: Availability varies by region and streaming service.

😂 Similar Vibe: My Spy: The Eternal City • The Game Plan • The Pacifier • Central Intelligence • The Sleepover • Kindergarten Cop
